name: Bloodsail Charts
summary: Bloodsail Charts are taken from the Buccaneer camp on the Wild Shore. Fleet Master Seahorn wants them brought to Booty Bay with the Bloodsail Orders so he can learn what the pirates are planning.

sections.title: Charts from the Shore
sections.body: Fleet Master Seahorn sends you to the Bloodsail Buccaneers’ camp on the Wild Shore. He wants their charts and written orders carried back to Booty Bay. With both in hand, he says the fleet can learn the Bloodsails’ plan.

faq.answer: The Bloodsail Charts are in the Bloodsail Buccaneer camp on the Wild Shore in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants the Bloodsail Charts and Bloodsail Orders.
Seahorn wants the charts and written orders to learn what the Bloodsail Buccaneers are planning.

faq.q: What should I bring back with the charts?
faq.answer: Bring the Bloodsail Orders with the Bloodsail Charts to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
